description: Search the commercial buses currently listed for sale by participating dealers. Filter by bus type, seats, wheelchair lift, condition and state. Returns public listing summaries with a link to each listing page. Dealer names and exact prices are not public; to reach the dealer, use request_bus.

bus_type.description: A category slug from list_bus_categories, e.g. cutaway-bus, school-bus, motorcoach.

query.description: Free text matched against the title, e.g. 'Ford E-450'.

state.description: Two-letter US state where the bus is, e.g. TX.

wheelchair_lift.description: true to show only units with a lift or ramp.

name: search_buses
